stage_2_story.text_en:
Every spring, David looks forward to working in his backyard vegetable garden. He starts early in the season by visiting the local market, where he picks out small seedlings of tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers. He also buys seeds for carrots and beans.

Back at home, David prepares the soil in his vegetable patch. He digs the earth, removes stones, and adds fresh compost. Then he plants the seedlings and seeds in neat rows, leaving enough space between each one so they can grow well.

After a week or two, tiny green sprouts begin to push through the soil. David feels happy every time he sees a new one appear. He waters the garden every morning, but this year he decided to install a simple irrigation system with small tubes that drip water slowly to each plant. This saves him time and keeps the soil moist.

As the weeks pass, the cucumber and tomato plants grow long vines that climb up the wooden stakes David placed in the ground. He also built a small greenhouse from clear plastic sheets, where he grows lettuce and herbs like basil and parsley. The greenhouse keeps these plants warm on cool nights.

By midsummer, the garden is full of color. The tomatoes are turning red, which means they are ripe and ready to pick. David fills a big basket with tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers, and fresh herbs. He is proud of his crop this year — it is the best one he has ever had.

That evening, David makes a big salad with everything he picked from the garden. His family sits together at the dinner table, and his children say it is the most delicious salad they have ever tasted. David smiles and thinks that all the hard work in the garden was worth it.

What does David buy at the local market?

questions.question: How does David arrange the plants in his garden?
options: (b) He plants them in neat rows with space between them

questions.question: Why did David install an irrigation system?
options: (a) Because his neighbor told him to
(b) Because he wanted to decorate the garden
(c) To save time and keep the soil moist
(d) Because the plants did not need water

questions.question: What do the cucumber and tomato plants grow?
options: (a) Short bushes close to the ground
(b) Long vines that climb up wooden stakes
(d) Wide leaves that cover the soil

questions.question: What does David grow inside his greenhouse?
options: (c) Lettuce and herbs like basil and parsley

questions.question: How does David know the tomatoes are ready to pick?
options: (a) They fall off the vine by themselves
(b) They are turning red, which means they are ripe
(c) The leaves around them turn yellow

questions.question: How does David feel about his crop this year?
options: (b) Worried because the vegetables taste bad
(c) Proud because it is the best crop he has ever had
(d) Upset because animals ate the vegetables

questions.question: What does David make with the vegetables he picked?
options: (c) A big salad for his family
